layout_sources: https://github.com/andyregan/aib2ynab/blob/main/tests/test_files/transactions.csv (2024: the header with its spaces after the first commas, quoted values, unquoted empty cells and currency, Debit/Credit Amount, Balance, Transaction Type, Local Currency Amount)
https://github.com/yacoob/beancount-aib (same header; dd/mm/yyyy; last row is the newest and carries the closing balance; commas removed from amounts before parsing)
notes: AIB Internet Banking "Export transactions" CSV for a current account: header "Posted Account, Posted Transactions Date, Description1, Description2, Description3, Debit Amount, Credit Amount,Balance,Posted Currency,Transaction Type,Local Currency Amount,Local Currency" (a space after the first six commas only). Values double-quoted except empty cells and the currency; dd/mm/yyyy; debits and credits as positive figures in their own columns with a point decimal (a comma thousands mark on large amounts is assumed from the importer that strips it), Balance after each line without a thousands mark, Transaction Type Debit/Credit/Direct Debit. Oldest first. LF and UTF-8 (ASCII content) assumed. Opening worked back from the first line.
